pages.text: Cutting uses exactly $(item)1 cured leaf$() and $(item)1 Chaveta$() placed orthogonally beside each other in a crafting grid. One cured leaf becomes $(item)3 loose tobacco$(). The Chaveta's location relative to the leaf determines the cut.

Relative to the $(item)leaf$():$(br2)$(thing)Chaveta above$() → Shag Cut$(br)$(thing)Chaveta left$() → Ribbon Cut$(br)$(thing)Chaveta right$() → Rough Cut$(br2)$(thing)Flake$() is a two-step preparation: first compress Rough Cut tobacco into a $(thing)Pressed Plug$(). In vanilla, seal Rough tobacco in a Tobacco Barrel, place a downward-facing Piston two blocks above it, and power the piston so its extended head presses onto the barrel. With Create, use a Mechanical Press. Then slice the Plug with a Chaveta placed below it in the crafting grid, or use a Deployer holding a Chaveta.$(br2)Diagonal placement does not work.
pages.title: Cut Layout

pages.text: Cuts matter to finished-product quality, but they refine rather than replace leaf quality:$(br2)$(thing)Cigarette:$() Shag ideal, Ribbon strong$(br)$(thing)Cigar:$() Rough ideal, Ribbon strong$(br)$(thing)Shisha:$() Rough ideal, Ribbon strong$(br2)Flake/Shag mismatches lower the score more noticeably.
pages.title: Best Uses

pages.text: Finished-product quality starts from the tobacco itself. Cigars additionally use $(item)75% filler + 25% wrapper$(). Cut suitability then applies a modest adjustment and only clearly unsuitable cuts impose a ceiling. The displayed score is also the score used for quality-based smoking bonuses.
